description.narrative: " Component One: Setting up a Social and Legal Rights Observatory This component includes the following activities: (i) setting up a social rights observatory to improve the quality and effectiveness of laws and regulations and their equitable implementationcomma by strengthening the capacity of Parliament to follow up on the implementation of said norms and strengthening the technical capacity of the central administration and decentralized institutions of the executive branch of government responsible for the implementation of said normscomma all of this through: (a) the selection of a set of norms (""the Selected Norms"") that particularly affect civil society (with a special focus on vulnerable groups) (the ""Targeted Groups"")comma evaluating and monitoring the knowledge that those groups have of said norms and of the rights that they entail; (b) the gathering of feedback from civil society on the adequacy of the Selected Norms and provision of said feedback to Parliament and (c) commacommathe identification of (A) the strengths of the central administration and decentralized institutions of the executive branch of government responsible for the implementation of the Selected Normscomma and (B) the institutional barriers that the referred central administration decentralized institutions face in the implementation of the Selected Norms. Component Two: Assessment and Strengthening of Selected Norms and their Implementation by the central administration and decentralized institutions of the executive branch of government (i) analysis and diagnosis of the implementation of Selected Norms by the central administration and decentralized institutions of the executive branch of government; (ii) analysis and diagnosis of the obstacles (legalcomma operationalcomma socialcomma culturalcomma etc) that (a) prevent users from receiving information about the Selected Norms and exercising their rights andcomma (b) prevent an adequate and transparent implementation of the Selected Norms; (iii) analysis of the institutional strengths of the entities within the executive branch of government in charge of the implementation of the Selected Norms which facilitate the exercise of the rights entailed in the Selected Norms by the Targeted Groups; and (iv) elaboration of recommendations to guarantee the effective implementation of the Selected Norms. Component Three: Improvement of the Knowledge of Selected Normscomma and Provision of Feedback from Stakeholders on said Norms (i) outreach activities (workshopscomma service-centerscomma media-at-large campaign) to improve the knowledge that the Targeted Groups have of the Selected Norms. (ii) workshops and provision of training for central administration and decentralized institutions of the executive branch of government that experience difficulties in the implementation of the Selected Norms (as identified in the above-referred diagnostic studies); and (iii) preparation of materials and issuance of protocols to guide future implementation of the Selected Norms by the central administration and decentralized institutions of the executive branch of government identified in the above-referred diagnostic studies. Component Four: Project Managementcomma Monitoring and Evaluation. (i) provision of support for the implementation of the Projectcomma and (ii) the carrying out of an evaluation impact and an external audit of the Project. (ii) Increase the accountability of the Uruguayan Government by strengthening its capacity to effectively develop and implement norms and regulations that impact vulnerable groups (includingcomma among otherscomma the unemployed and young people).
